data.name: ABHISHEK SHARMA
data.player_statement:
A complete player, ABHISHEK SHARMA has made a big mark in cricket. With 50 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 41, with an average of 13.24 and a quick strike rate of 117.05. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 40 sixes and 38 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 51.0 overs, taking 22 wickets at an economy rate of 12.02. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
